description:
Get Map Contributor Reviews

Lists all Google Maps reviews authored by a specific Local Guide / contributor by contributorId, with language/country targeting and nextPageToken pagination. Returns per-review rating, text, date, place name, place address, photos, and owner responses. Use for reviewer reputation checks, detecting fake/bot review patterns, local-guide activity analysis, and building review-author profiles for trust scoring.

gl.description: The two-letter country code for the country you want to limit the search to. Provide one exact documented value (245 allowed), e.g. `ac`, `af`.

hl.description: The two-letter language code for the language you want to use for the search. Provide one exact documented value (159 allowed), e.g. `af`, `ak`.

nextPageToken.description: Defines the next page token. It is used for retrieving the next page results.

num.description: Number of results per page, ranging from 10 to 200.
